title: Cloud Nurdz | ICED | Pink Guava Passion ICED 100ml
description:
Cloud Nurdz – Pink Guava Passion ICED 100ml
Experience a frosty twist with Cloud Nurdz’s Iced Pink Guava Passion eJuice. This refreshing e-liquid combines the exotic essence of Pink Guava, passionfruit with an invigorating menthol finish. It’s the perfect choice for vapers seeking a tropical escape with a dash of ice.
